input.quote: b. paying the applicable early termination charges, if any, specified in Attachment A and applicable Service Option Attachments.
input.rationale: Section 3.4(b) conditions our termination-for-convenience right on paying "early termination charges" fixed in Attachment A and the Service Option Attachments, which are not reproduced or capped in this Agreement. That is a stipulated, Customer-payable termination amount of unknown and potentially unlimited size, so it fails the fallback (early-termination fee capped at three months' fees as the sole liquidated amount) on a material term. No other Customer-payable liquidated damages or penalties appear (Section 3.3 confirms IBM cannot recover these charges where IBM is in breach, and Section 9.2 caps our liability generally); the "late payment fees" reference in Section 4.2 is ordinary interest and is noted only. Redline adopts the fallback: a three-months'-charges cap and sole-remedy wording, since the early-termination charge is part of the bargain for our convenience-termination right.

ops.oldText: b. paying the applicable early termination charges, if any, specified in Attachment A and applicable Service Option Attachments.
ops.newText: b. paying the applicable early termination charges, if any, specified in Attachment A and applicable Service Option Attachments, provided that such charges will not exceed, in the aggregate, three (3) months' charges for the terminated Services (calculated using the average monthly charges for such Services over the three (3) months preceding the notice of termination) and will be the sole amount payable by Customer, and IBM's sole remedy, as a result of such termination for convenience.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] Our position is that no liquidated damages or penalties are payable by us; where an early-termination charge is unavoidable we cap it at three months' charges as the sole amount due on termination for convenience. As drafted the charge is set in the attachments and is uncapped, so we cannot quantify our exposure.
proposal.summary: Cap early termination charges under Section 3.4(b) at three months' charges and make them the sole termination-for-convenience remedy.
